proposal.label: needs more info
proposal.comment: Could you confirm the exact DuckDB build that reproduces this? The report mentions v1.5.2 in the description but lists DuckDB Version: 1.5.3 in the template. Please paste the precise output of `duckdb --version` (or `SELECT version();` from the same environment) and say whether you used a released binary or a build from source. This exact version/build is needed because optimizer behavior differs between builds and blocks reproducing the planner-time failure.
proposal.rationale: The report provides a complete SQL repro but contains a contradictory DuckDB version (v1.5.2 in the narrative vs 1.5.3 in the template). Exact release or commit/build info is essential to reproduce optimizer/planner-time crashes since behavior can change between builds; without it, we cannot deterministically reproduce the issue.
